Context: 5. Relaxations.-

prescribed under the Recruitment Rules. A person appointed as 'Trainee' has to acquire the minimum educational qualification in 5 years. The emoluments of these trainees, during the period of their training and before they are absorbed in the Government as employees, will be governed by the minimum of the -15 Pay Band without any Grade Pay. In addition, they will be granted all applicable Allowances, like Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance and Transport Allowance at the admissible rates.
